executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $166.6 per resident day (37.3% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 3.0% (Connecticut median 2.5%).

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,105,492, $27.49 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $583,343 (52.8%), allocated fringe $114,730 (10.4%), non-wage costs $407,419 (36.9%). Raw food was $361,310 ($8.98 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61).
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $568,696, $14.14 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $431,343 (75.8%), allocated fringe $84,835 (14.9%), non-wage costs $52,518 (9.2%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $228,933, $5.69 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $164,208 (71.7%), allocated fringe $32,296 (14.1%), non-wage costs $32,429 (14.2%).
Cost year 2025: the home reported $1,162,951 in management fees (cost report line m12), $28.91 per resident day (Connecticut median $13.39 among homes reporting a fee).
Missing data: cost years 2015, 2017, 2018 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
